services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive cleaning solutions tailored to your needs, ensuring a spotless and comfortable environment.

renovation.title: Post-renovation cleaning
renovation.text: After a renovation, dust, debris, and construction residues can make your space uncomfortable. Our post-renovation cleaning service removes all traces of dirt, ensuring your home or office is fresh, spotless, and ready to be enjoyed.

move.title: Pre & post-move cleaning
move.text: Moving can be stressful, but a thorough cleaning ensures a smooth transition. We prepare your new home by deep cleaning before you move in and leave your old space immaculate for the next occupants, focusing on every detail, from carpets to kitchen appliances.

office.title: Office & commercial cleaning
office.text: A clean workspace is essential for productivity and employee well-being. Our office cleaning services include dusting, vacuuming, sanitizing common areas, and disinfecting surfaces to create a professional and healthy environment for your team and clients.

cleaning.title: House cleaning
cleaning.text: Whether you need regular maintenance or an intensive deep clean, our house cleaning service is designed to keep your home fresh, hygienic, and welcoming. We take care of dusting, vacuuming, sanitizing bathrooms, kitchens, and more, using eco-friendly products for a safe and healthy space.

roofs.title: Gardens, fences, walls & roofs cleaning
roofs.text: Outdoor areas accumulate dirt, moss, and weather stains over time. Our high-pressure washing service restores the beauty of your garden paths, fences, walls, and roofs by removing grime, mold, and other build-ups, helping to maintain and protect your property's exterior.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our services.
FAQ.question1: What cleaning products do you use?
FAQ.answer1: We use eco-friendly and non-toxic cleaning products that are safe for all environments.
FAQ.question2: Can I schedule a cleaning outside of normal hours?
FAQ.answer2: Yes, we offer flexible hours, including weekends and evenings upon request.
FAQ.question3: Do you bring your own equipment?
FAQ.answer3: Yes, our team is fully equipped with professional cleaning tools and products.
